decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C512-10 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:20. The stope holds 140 t at 13.4 g/t, about 60 oz. Central trucks have spare capacity (91 t/h vs 63 t/h inflow). LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.5 oz/h. It takes 0.69 h to arrive and loads about 29 t/h, worth about 12 oz/h. That clears the stope well before 17:00. The cost is about 2.5 oz of development value, so the net gain is roughly 45-55 oz. LH-09's heading is worth 2 oz/h and LH-10 is in maintenance until 14:00, so neither is used.
